Hi everyone,

Starting the 15th, on-call will switch from one-week to two-week shifts. Expect fewer handoffs and more continuity for responders. We’ll update the rotation and send revised schedules and calendar invites soon. If this creates a conflict or you have questions, please reply to me or post in the on-call channel. We’ll review how the change is working after the first cycle and adjust as needed.

Thanks for your flexibility — much appreciated.

[Your name]
